messages:
josh: Quick RFC follow-up — thinking about adding an explicit latency budget gate into the intake pipeline. TL;DR: models that exceed p95 inference latency on our mini-bench get flagged before full bench. Thoughts?

tara: Do you mean measured on our smoke runner or the runtime profile collector? smoke runner is cheaper but less realistic.

mike: We should separate cold-start vs steady-state. p95_warm is more relevant for steady latencies; cold can skew fail rates.

ann: Also need to account for quantized variants — they trade quality for latency. Gate should consider variant mapping (float32 / int8 / q4f).

josh: Proposal: run a 50-sample mini-bench in the intake worker that includes: cold-start samples, warm runs, adapter variants when present. Record p50/p95 and a simple QA check for degenerate outputs. If p95_warm > route_budget -> tag FAIL_LATENCY and route to slowpath.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: mini-bench executed for model:mnist-xl-v2. results => p95_warm=312ms, p95_cold=720ms, repeats_detected=0.

tara: We need deterministic golden inputs to reduce noise. Use the curated golden sequences from smokehouse + a short housekeeping prompt.

mike: Also capture tokenization and effective seqlen distribution. A model that passes on short sequences but fails on 95th-percentile app sequences is a false pass.

ann: Edge case: adapters/LoRA — some adapter stacks inflate latency unexpectedly because of deserialization. We should include adapter-inflated runs when adapter config present.

josh: Agreed. Also add a tiny generation check: fail if more than 8 repeating tokens or if model returns an empty gen for >20% of samples.

josh: Gate config sketch:
```
latency_budget_ms:
  route_default: 400
  realtime_chat: 250
  background_batch: 1200
bench_samples: 50
warm_runs: 10
adapter_coverage: true
fail_on: ["p95_warm > route_budget", "generation_repeats >= 8", "empty_gen_rate >= 0.2"]
notify_mode: true
```

tara: Can we start notify-only for a week (no automatic reject) so product can review noisy flags?

mike: +1 for notify-only rollout. Also add a model-card flag: "perf: needs tuning" so solutions engineers can follow up.

josh: I'll draft a tiny RFC and add this to the intake checklist. cc @ann to help enumerate adapter cases and @tara for golden-set ownership.
